note: Manual inputs for phase0-loops.mjs (#1648 Phase 0 idea A). bodyIndependentRemediationRounds = remediation rounds after an independent (non-GitHub) review that the PR body states, without timestamps; 0 when the body states none or only passes. sameTypeRecurrence is judged from the finding texts of consecutive rounds (same invariant or same path). capWouldShorten = a round cap plus escalation (split / owner decision) plausibly shortens the work, per the finding texts.

prs.label: non-Git project handling (code, then docs)
prs.rationale: Round 1 is bare-repository detection in code, round 2 is the worktree condition in USAGE; same theme, different invariant and path.

prs.label: unrelated
prs.rationale: Body records two independent-review remediations in separate audit scopes (migration/Git output, then whole-repo docs); no shared invariant stated.

prs.label: fixture server-side email validation; review start precondition; trust of agent-writable Git metadata
prs.rationale: Email validation of the same fixture file is reopened in rounds 1,2,3,5 (domain labels, local-part dots, local-part symbols, 64-octet limit); one owner decision on the validation spec at the cap would remove the piecemeal regex rounds. Rounds 2-3 both target the review-start condition; rounds 4-5 both target host trust of agent-writable Git metadata. Time after round 3 is mostly new scope, not the loop.

prs.label: Docker cleanup deletes resources not owned by the worktree
prs.rationale: Body: five independent-review rounds; three wrong-deletion paths (subdir compose name collision, down without -p, zero-container ownership vacuously true) share one ownership invariant. The split actually taken (#1613 moves the judgement into a deterministic read-only CLI) is the escalation a cap would have triggered earlier.

prs.label: distinct findings
prs.rationale: Independent round 1 (precision/count wording, extraction coverage, missing scripts), round 2 (Low wording/anonymisation) and 12 CodeRabbit findings over different scripts; no invariant recurs across consecutive rounds.

prs.label: distinct findings
prs.rationale: Asset-count upper-bound regression, then timeout termination guarantee of a separate runner; different invariants.

qualityNote: Protocol section 品質側の測定 (A). Severity mapping: CodeRabbit Critical/Major = High/Medium (real defect when remediated in code/contract); Minor/Nitpick = Low. Independent-review severities are taken from the PR body. Covers every PR with R>=3 under L, B, D or X. Rounds under B are commit bursts and carry no finding text unless a GitHub review falls inside them. resolvableByCapTransition = the defect could still have been resolved if the only transitions after the cap were split or owner decision (never accepting it unresolved). The classification has not yet been checked by an independent context.
